summary: Backend-only testing of Iteration 112 P0 fixes: (a) assignment deletion task lifecycle (ACTIVE -> CANCELLED / ORPHANED), (b) audit endpoint for cancelled/orphaned tasks, (c) 409 PENDING_APPROVAL_EDIT_NOT_ALLOWED when editing a record with pending_approval, (d) 409 MULTIPLE_PENDING_EDITS_NOT_ALLOWED when a pending edit approval already exists, and (e) admin_override=true bypasses both checks. All 8 pytest cases passed (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: esg_assignments/service.delete_assignment: 'approval_requests' cancellation uses entity_id = assignment.entity_id (category/section name), not the actual record id. This will only cancel pending approvals whose entity_id equals the assignment.entity_id which is rarely true for record edit approvals (those use record_id). Consider joining via assignment_id or the assignment's tasks/records. Currently a no-op in most real cases.

esg_records/service.update_record: the MULTIPLE_PENDING_EDITS check runs even when the record itself is in pending_approval; it duplicates work with the PENDING_APPROVAL_EDIT_NOT_ALLOWED branch. Fine functionally, but note the pending_approval branch only inspects requests where status is 'pending' or 'in_review' - if a pending_request is missing (data inconsistency) it silently allows the edit; consider still 409 on approval_status=pending_approval alone.
esg_assignments/router audit/cancelled-tasks: lifecycle_status is accepted as a free-form string; consider validating against an Enum {cancelled, orphaned, archived} to reject bad values with 422.

esg_assignments/service.archive_cancelled_tasks compares cancelled_at (string ISO) to cutoff.isoformat() lexicographically. Works for UTC ISO 8601 with tzinfo but fragile if tz offsets vary; document assumption or store cancelled_at as datetime.
seed_data_creation: Test creates transient ESG records and directly seeds approval_requests + lifecycle_status tasks in Mongo, then cleans them up in finally blocks. Any leftover TEST_ records are also removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_p0_lifecycle_and_approvals_iter112.py. Requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME env vars. Uses pymongo directly for state seeding (approval_status + approval_requests) since the natural approval workflow requires facility-level records and multi-user approvers not present in the target org.
rca of the issue: N/A - all three P0 fixes verified working as specified.
